HITL-EDF32917.proposed_message_urdulish:
🔬 **Lab Report Ki Wazahat: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)**

• **Report Ki Value:** `8.4%`
• **Normal Reference Range:** Normal hadd `< 5.7%` hoti hai (Prediabetes: `5.7% - 6.4%`, Diabetes: `≥ 6.5%`)
• **Tajziya (Status):** **Normal Hadd Se Zyada (High / Ghair-Mutawazan)**

💡 **Tafseel:** HbA1c pichlay 2 se 3 maah ki ausat sugar ko zahir karta hai. 8.4% ka matlab hai ke blood sugar barhi hui hai aur doctori mashwara darqar hai.

🛡️ **Non-Diagnostic Safety Disclaimer:** Yeh AI wazahat hai aur kisi bimari ki tashkhees (diagnosis) nahi karti. Sahi ilaj ke liye Dr. Bilal Saeed (Internal Medicine) se appointment book karein.

HITL-70F13153.proposed_message_urdulish:
🔬 **Lab Report Ki Wazahat: ALT / SGPT (Jigar Ka Test)**

• **Report Ki Value:** `85 U/L`
• **Normal Reference Range:** `7 - 56 U/L`
• **Tajziya (Status):** **Normal Hadd Se Zyada (High)**

💡 **Tafseel:** ALT jigar ka enzyme hai. 85 U/L jigar par mamooli sozish ya fatty liver ki nishandahi kar sakta hai.

🛡️ **Non-Diagnostic Safety Disclaimer:** Tashkhees ke liye Dr. Usman Sheikh (Gastroenterology) se checkup karwayein.
